headline: Blanked, but with chances
record_line: Yesterday: 0-3 on the top plays · Season: 44-194

entries.headline: Teoscar Hernández stayed in the yard
entries.story: Teoscar Hernández went 0-for-4 with 1 BB against Andrew Abbott and the Cincinnati Reds. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 2 times.

entries.headline: Carter Jensen came close
entries.story: Carter Jensen went 1-for-4 with 1 BB and 1 RBI against Cristian Javier and the Houston Astros. Closest call was a double in the 8th: "Astros challenged (tag play), call on the field was upheld: Carter Jensen doubles (33) on a line drive to right fielder Jorge Barrosa. Josh Rojas scores. Isaac Collins scores. Carter Jensen to 3rd. Throwing error by right fielder Jorge Barrosa." The power showed up; the carry did not.
